_read_me: All home page copy lives here. Edit the text in quotes and keep the {n} markers: the site fills each {n} with a live count from the database. An "art" value of null keeps the current illustration; set it to an image address, or to SVG markup beginning <svg, to replace it.

site.title: The Syren Protocols
site.description: Some cities are buried. Some are documented. In 2034 Warsaw was both. What follows is what survived.
site._placeholder_read_me: Shown on any entry that has no images of its own, marked PLACEHOLDER. A real image replaces it automatically. To change it, upload a new placeholder.jpg to the images bucket. To switch it off, set the value below to an empty string.

hero.headline: When memory becomes a weapon,
hero.intro: Some cities are buried. Some are documented. In 2034 Warsaw was both. What follows is what survived.
hero.intro_secondary: Assembling testimony from a city that no longer exists as we knew it.

portal.heading: One project, four ways in
portal._read_me: The four cards, in this order. title is the large heading, code and label make the line beneath it, text is an optional description, left empty for now ({n} is the live entry count). href is where the card goes (search opens the search box); leave it empty for a card that is not ready yet, and put a word such as Coming in status. art is a picture placed behind the graphic: null for none, or an image address.

timeline.heading: The record, in order.
timeline.text: From the first flood to the last testimony. Select a moment to read it where it happens in the story.
timeline._read_me: One line per moment, in order. date is shown as written. kind sets the icon: flood, occupation, person, protocol or testimony. label is the line of text. story is the address of the Story page it opens (the part after #story- in the page address). A line with only gap draws a break in the line, for a stretch of time the timeline skips. Every date and label here is taken from the manuscript, which is the authority.
